title: LG-W0-07 上游 graph 探针契约（多包综合版）

upstream.run_env: 干净独立 venv（uv sync 生成），不依赖 site-packages 原版、不写入 /tmp、不读取 PYTHONPATH

capabilities.name: typed_state_reducer
capabilities.contract: TypedDict 字段可用 Annotated[list, operator.add] 声明合并语义；并发写入经 reducer 追加合并而非最后写入覆盖

capabilities.name: conditional_routing
capabilities.contract: 依据当前状态返回下一节点名集合，路由显式可测试；本探针以 route 字段决定并行扇出或直接收束

capabilities.name: parallel_fanout_superstep
capabilities.contract: 路由函数返回多个节点名时触发确定性并行扇出，屏障处由 reducer 汇合，全部完成后才进入下游

capabilities.name: checkpoint_durable
capabilities.contract: compile(checkpointer=...) 每次超步后持久化状态；get_state_history 可回放 thread 完整 checkpoint 历史

capabilities.name: streaming_state_events
capabilities.contract: 按节点粒度推送状态变更事件，客户端可逐步接收而非等整图结束

capabilities.name: subgraph_composition
capabilities.contract: 子图作为节点接入父图，子图本地状态与父图隔离（本探针写 sub_total 先 +1 再 ×2）；父图 log 不被子图重放/污染

probe.graph: START -> start -> (route) -> {pa, pb, pc} -> join -> sub(子图) -> finish -> END
probe.state: TypedDict(log: Annotated[list, operator.add], route: str, sub_total: int)
probe.prebuilt_probe: ToolNode / tools_condition / create_react_agent 可导入且符号可用
